name: Nullharbor
notes: Ship/station edges: #space stays a transparent 2D canvas (Fold white-flash protection) but is no longer desynchronized. Chrome's desync hint can front-buffer and tear; under the HUD overlay that read as vsync-off shredding on hard hull and station rims after 2.16.2.

World-space chase camera snaps to whole backing pixels so ships and stations lock against the starfield during cruise. Distant stars still use the unsapped interpolated camera (2.15.7 stair-step stay gone).
Sky bake-before-fill, backing slack, and launch/jump art warmup from 2.16.2 are unchanged. Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.16.3. Save keys stay farbound-save-v2.
